title: Super Soft!
text: Super Soft!. I love soft blankets! This one is super soft! It was not what I expected at all for a Vera Bradley blanket. I have at least one other VB blanket and it has a lovely floral print all over it. This one is solid and has the Vera Bradley print on the edges for accent. I have this in my bedroom as a throw blanket at the foot of my bed.

product_metadata.title: Vera Bradley Fleece Solid Throw Blanket
features: FOR HOME & AWAY -- Whether it's a long road trip or a chilly morning at home, curl up with something cozy & beautiful - this blanket is for every woman looking to keep warm while adding a dash of color to her every day

CHIC & COZY -- Crafted from a fluffy & soft solid fleece with a beautiful 2" X 2" quilt technique - you can toss this throw blanket over the couch or chair, or drape over the end of your bed to give your room the perfect cozy accent

STYLISH, LIGHTWEIGHT & SIZED RIGHT -- The Vera Bradley Solid Throw Blanket measures 80 inches high & 50 inches wide, generously sized for spreading out or cuddling close - either way, you'll always want to stay wrapped up in this fleece blanket
MACHINE WASHABLE -- This product is built to last, machine washable, & fade resistant to keep you fun & fashionable
COMPLETE THE SET -- This item pairs perfectly with our Vera Bradley Fleece Solid Throw Pillow Cover With Hypoallergenic Insert
description: Stay warm and sleep peacefully in the Vera Bradley 80 X 50 Fleece Solid Throw Blanket that keeps you cozy. Made of polyester microfleece with polyester trims. Contrasting detail on the edge with multicolored printed design. Machine wash, tumble dry.
